title: feat: video.bsky.app transcoding + ATProto login flow
body:
## Summary

- **VideoServiceUploader** — Routes video uploads through Bluesky's video transcoding service (`video.bsky.app`) instead of direct PDS `uploadBlob`. Produces playable video embeds on bsky.app.
- **ATProto login flow docs and contracts** — Design docs, smoke tests, and runbooks for divine.video ATProto user provisioning
- **PDS host backfill** — Helpers for production PDS host configuration

## Video Service Integration

New `VideoServiceUploader` implements the existing `BlobUploader` trait:
1. Gets service auth token from PDS (`getServiceAuth` with `aud=PDS_DID`)
2. Uploads to `video.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.video.uploadVideo`
3. Polls `getJobStatus` until transcoding completes
4. Returns transcoded blob ref for the post embed

Non-video uploads (avatars, banners) still go through direct PDS `uploadBlob`.

Controlled by `VIDEO_SERVICE_ENABLED` env var (default: `false`).

## Files

- `crates/divine-atbridge/src/video_service.rs` — new VideoServiceUploader
- `crates/divine-atbridge/src/config.rs` — video service config fields
- `crates/divine-atbridge/src/pipeline.rs` — `upload_blob_for_user()` trait extension
- `crates/divine-atbridge/src/runtime.rs` — conditional uploader wiring
- `docs/runbooks/` — ATProto login flow documentation

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo check -p divine-atbridge` compiles
- [x] Manually tested video.bsky.app flow — 78 playable videos posted to Bluesky
- [ ] Integration test with VIDEO_SERVICE_ENABLED=true on staging
